options.name: access_level
options.description: Access level of the access token. The value V(planner) was added in community.general 11.3.0.

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: expires_at
options.description: Expiration date of the access token in C(YYYY-MM-DD) format. Make sure to quote this value in YAML to ensure it is kept as a string and not interpreted as a YAML date.

options.name: project
options.description: ID or full path of project in the form of group/name.

options.name: recreate
options.description: Whether the access token is recreated if it already exists. When V(never) the token is never recreated. When V(always) the token is always recreated. When V(state_change) the token is recreated if there is a difference between desired state and actual state.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Scope of the access token. The values V(manage_runner) and V(self_rotate) were added in community.general 11.3.0.

options.name: state
options.description: When V(present) the access token is added to the project if it does not exist. When V(absent) it is removed from the project if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
